thread:
jamie.ops: incident bot alert — multiple customer-facing 5xxs and high tail latency on hosted inference in us-west-2. likely continuous-batching regression. paging and KV cache is spiking. escalating.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • id: INC-2026-0423-07 • severity: P1 • impacted: Hosted API (us-west-2) • visible errors: 502/503 spikes • runbook: cont-batch_kvcache_paging.md • oncall: @nina-sre

nina-sre: picking up. can someone drop recent deploys? saw a config push from carlos ~10m ago around batch tuning.

carlos-ml: that was a tweak to continuous batching defaults for an internal traffic profile — lowered default max_batch_tokens to 65536 -> then we added a new heuristic change to allow unbounded max_num_seqs when seq len < 64. intended to improve throughput for short chats.

nina-sre: looks like heuristic misfired — we're seeing huge batch sizes for a subset of traffic with many short sequences, causing memory pressure and KV cache thrash + paging to disk. tail latency > 20s for some requests, and the serving layer returning 5xx when OOM or disk read errors.

jamie.ops: customer impact? any high-revenue tenants affected?

sara-support: Support flags: 3 customers reported failures > 1k reqs in last 15m; names in support thread. Escalating to account managers. Some saw tokenization anomalies too (partial responses).

leo-engine: adding logs — here's an excerpt from node 7: ```
[2026-04-23T07:12:03Z] batch_id=237412 size_tokens=129830 max_num_seqs=4096 runtime_mem=48GB kvcache_evictions=12000 paging_io=37MB/s warn: high-latency
[2026-04-23T07:12:07Z] ERR OOM allocating attn_state
```

nina-sre: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable continuous batching on impacted pool(s) 2) reduce max_batch_tokens to 8k 3) enforce max_num_seqs cap to 256 4) bump KV cache soft-eviction to be more aggressive 5) rolling restart of a few hot nodes to clear thrashing. Who can run the disable?

carlos-ml: I can revert heuristic and push a config hotfix but that takes ~5m to propagate. If we need immediate stop, ops can toggle the runtime flag.

jamie.ops: @deploy-bot can you cut the runtime toggle to disable continuous batching on gw-pool-usw2-prod? Use emergency flag.

deploy-bot: Action accepted. Executing: `rctl runtime update --pool gw-pool-usw2-prod --set continuous_batching=false --reason "INC-2026-0423-07 emergency disable"`

deploy-bot: Update complete on 8/10 nodes, waiting for remaining nodes to drain. Observability: batch sizes collapsing, but a few nodes still have backpressure.

nina-sre: while that rolls, let's apply the smaller caps so even if cont-batch re-enables, it won't blow up. Carlos, can you push config: ```
continuous_batching.default_max_batch_tokens=8192
continuous_batching.max_num_seqs=256
continuous_batching.request_timeout_ms=15000
```

carlos-ml: pushed via config service. Confirmed commit id c3f9b7. Will propagate in ~90s.

leo-engine: KV cache eviction policy change applied (soft_eviction_threshold from 0.8 -> 0.6) on the pool. This should reduce paging.

jamie.ops: monitoring: traffic 5xx rate dropped from 4.8% -> 0.6% after disable and caps. Latency p95 down from 12.2s -> 420ms. Good sign.

incident-bot: UPDATE • INC-2026-0423-07 • mitigation in progress • next update in 10m • runbook step: notify customers if >30m impact

nina-sre: plan for next 30m: keep continuous batching disabled until we validate the new caps for 30m under load. Then, do a slow canary (1 node) with the safe caps and telemetry to abort if paging_io > 10MB/s or kvcache_evictions spike. Carlos, coordinate canary with me.

carlos-ml: agreed. Also will add a safeguard in the batching heuristic to respect max_num_seqs even for short seqs. I'll open a PR and attach QA metrics.

sara-support: drafting customer comms. Will notify affected accounts that we've mitigated the issue and are performing controlled reenablement. Need timeline estimate: ETA stable in 45-60m?

jamie.ops: yes ETA ~45m. Assigning follow-up: postmortem owner = nina-sre, followup engineers = carlos-ml, leo-engine. Sara to coordinate customer updates.

nina-sre: handing off to on-call for the next shift — @leo-engine will lead monitoring for the next 2 hours. I'm staying for handoff notes.

leo-engine: taking over. Current status: cont-batch disabled on gw-pool-usw2-prod, caps applied clusterwide, KV eviction more aggressive, 5xx rate stabilized at 0.3%. Will keep an eye on paging IO and token backlog.

jamie.ops: thanks all. Postmortem checklist: root cause (heuristic bypassed max_num_seqs), timeline, RCA on why KV cache paged, monitoring gaps (no guard on max_batch_tokens), followups (pre-commit gating), and automated safety toggles.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) • id: INC-2026-0423-07 • resolution: continuous batching disabled + config caps + KV eviction change • total duration: ~42m • postmortem owner: nina-sre

sara-support: customers updated. Closing support escalation for affected accounts.

nina-sre: creating postmortem draft now, will assign tasks and timelines. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
